steps.en: OIC opens the work item and sees the error notices
steps.id: OIC membuka work item dan melihat notice yang error
steps.why_en: There is no work item and the dashboard is empty.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada work item dan dashboard kosong.

steps.en: The latest known address is shown on screen
steps.id: Alamat terakhir yang diketahui tampil di layar
steps.why_en: Only a generic address screen opened by ID search shows it, not a work item.
steps.why_id: Hanya layar alamat generik lewat pencarian ID yang menampilkannya, bukan work item.

steps.en: The address creation date is shown
steps.why_en: The screen shows no address creation date.
steps.why_id: Layar tidak menampilkan tanggal pembuatan alamat.

steps.en: OIC can choose to amend the address or reject the notice
steps.id: OIC bisa memilih ubah alamat atau tolak notice
steps.why_en: Only amending the address exists; there is no reject action.
steps.why_id: Hanya ubah alamat yang ada; tidak ada aksi tolak.
